data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement `plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` — an idempotent migrator that rewrites `.claude/dso-config.conf` in place to use `dso.workflow=<local|ci-pr>` as the canonical key, following the established `ticket-migrate-*.sh` pattern.

**Why**: Existing host projects have legacy configs. The migrator provides a zero-manual-effort upgrade path: run it once (silently from skill preambles, marker-gated), and the config is rewritten atomically. This is the companion to the read-config.sh shim (S1) — together they make the transition invisible to operators.

**Scope**:
- IN: New `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` script; marker gate (`.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated`); `--dry-run` flag; plugin-source-repo self-guard (including false-positive test); atomic write (temp file + fsync + rename); sentinel creation post-rename; grammar validation (reject inline comments after values, quoted values, duplicate keys, CRLF line endings); backup detection for prior failed runs; idempotency shell tests
- OUT: Post-sentinel lockout (S3), onboarding write path (S4), hot-path script updates (S5)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, running `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` on a legacy fixture project rewrites `.claude/dso-config.conf` to contain `dso.workflow=<local|ci-pr>` exactly once, and each of the four legacy keys appears only as a commented-out line annotated `# migrated to dso.workflow (v<plugin-ver>)`
  ← Satisfies: SC1 (migrator rewrites config)
- When this story is complete, running the migrator twice on the same fixture project produces a zero-byte diff on the second run (idempotency)
  ← Satisfies: SC3 (idempotency)
- When this story is complete, `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --dry-run` reads and reports without modifying any file
  ← Satisfies: SC3 (--dry-run support)
- When this story is complete, the migrator exits 0 without modifying anything when run from within the plugin own source tree (self-guard); a host project with a `plugins/dso/` subdirectory that is NOT the plugin source repo is correctly treated as a host project (false-positive self-guard test)
  ← Satisfies: SC3 (plugin-source-repo self-guard)
- When this story is complete, the migrator writes to a temp file in the same directory, fsyncs, then renames atomically; the sentinel `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` is created only after the config-rename succeeds
  ← Satisfies: SC3 (atomic write semantics)
- When this story is complete, the migrator rejects files with inline comments after values, quoted values, duplicate keys, or CRLF line endings with a non-zero exit and clear diagnostic, without mutating the file
  ← Satisfies: SC3 (grammar validation)
- When this story is complete, if `.dso-config.conf.pre-migrate-backup` from a prior failed run exists, the migrator detects it and does not overwrite it
  ← Satisfies: SC3 (backup detection)
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic in `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh`

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The canonical legacy→dso.workflow mapping must be implemented once and shared by both `read-config.sh` (S1) and `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` (S2). Either extract a shared helper function sourced by both, or add a parity test that runs identical fixture configs through both code paths and asserts equal output. Without this, shim and migrator can drift, producing different dso.workflow values for the same legacy config — exactly the failure class this epic eliminates.
- [Testing] Shell test covers: twice-run idempotency, --dry-run, self-guard (true positive and false positive), atomic write failure simulation, all grammar rejection cases

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a host project maintainer, the idempotent migrator rewrites dso-config.conf to use dso.workflow
